messages:
alex_chen: Quick sanity thread for Predict GA readiness. Need final alignment on: SLA wording, pricing meter granularity, canary cohorts, docs gaps, support coverage. Can we close by EOD? @samira_k @jonah_p @maria_g

samira_k: From infra side: autoscaler policy validated on staging (scale to 80% headroom). We should document the burst-to-dedicated handoff when queues exceed threshold. Also propose canary cohorts: internal-only -> 1% tenants -> 10% -> open. Ops bot reserved time slots: 2024-05-06 09:00Z for first canary.

jonah_p: Pricing note: meter at token-level with 1k-token granularity. Finops asked for a 30-day trial credit for new orgs; legal wants exact language on refunds. I'll add billing examples to the FAQ.

maria_g: SLA draft updated with an exceptions section: scheduled maint windows excluded, but emergency maintenance should be communicated within 15m. Penalty language is service credit up to one month pro-rated. Need product + legal approval. Link: https://staging.docs/redwood/predict/sla

alex_chen: For docs: we need 3 short items before GA: quickstart, quota/overage blurb, and migration note for Dedicated. Streaming audio sample can be marked "preview" and shipped post-GA. Who owns quota blurb? @jonah_p or @samira_k?

jonah_p: I'll draft quota/overage blurb. Include example: "If you exceed monthly quota, requests return 429 with header X-Quota-Reset."

ops-bot: CI smoke check schedule created: every 5m against canary endpoint. Preflight summary: capacity=OK, 7-day burn-in simulated, kv-cache warmup healthy.

sophie_t: Support: I'll be primary POC for first 72h after GA. Need one backup for nights (UTC-7). Also requesting a short runbook for degraded-model fallback: steps, runbook link, and automated rollback trigger.

samira_k: Runbook link added to staging runbooks. Degraded-model fallback will switch to quantized-v2 variant, notify #incidents with summary, and create an incident.

alex_chen: Canary rollout cadence: internal -> 1% tenants (24h) -> 10% (48h) -> full (monitor 72h). If p99 > 400ms or errors > 1% trigger rollback. Owners: alex_chen (launch lead), samira_k (infra), jonah_p (pricing), maria_g (SLA/docs), sophie_t (support).

maria_g: One blocker: legal hasn't cleared the refund clause. I'll ping legal and update thread when cleared.

jonah_p: Example smoke command for docs/CI: ```bash
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/predict -d '{"input":"short test"}' | jq . && echo $?
``` Asserts HTTP 200 + response.tokens > 0. Adding to canary CI job now.

alex_chen: Great. If no objections by EOD I'll call this green and schedule the ship notice. Leaving final ack window open for legal and docs owners. :eyes:
